stories.title: Our guide to every NFL Week 5 game: Matchup previews, predictions, picks and nuggets
stories.summary: Bears vs. Packers? 49ers vs. Seahawks? There are 14 more games in Week 5, and we have picks, predictions and more for all of them.

stories.title: Why some NFL coaches are struggling with late-game decisions
stories.summary: Scoring too early and kicking the ball into the end zone can be costly, as the Cowboys learned.

stories.title: Legendary coach, Hall of Fame TE Ditka dies at age 86
stories.summary: Mike Ditka, a Hall of Fame tight end who became an NFL legend for his time as coach of the Bears, has died at the age of 86.

stories.title: LeBron on 10-point Sixers debut: Still adjusting, but 'the game is the game'
stories.summary: LeBron James, who joined the 76ers this summer, had 10 points, five assists and four rebounds in the first half of his debut with Philadelphia.

stories.title: Tabled talk NYC: Knicks pause KAT, Hart deal discussions
stories.summary: The Knicks have said they are tabling contract extension talks with Karl-Anthony Towns and Josh Hart "until later in the season and will remain solely focused on preparing for the start of the season."
